what: Omnicom is one of the world's largest advertising groups. It plans and buys media, creates campaigns, and runs public relations, healthcare marketing and customer experience agencies. It merged with Interpublic in 2025.
customers: Large global brands across consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, technology, finance and automotive.
money: media planning and buying, creative agencies
moat: Global media buying scale that secures better rates than any single advertiser could, plus relationships with brands that span decades and many agencies.
risks: It reported a near-zero net margin after merger charges
Large advertisers are moving spending to platforms that need no agency
Integrating Interpublic is a very large undertaking with overlapping clients
opportunities: Revenue grew about 10% last year including the merger
Cost synergies from combining two large agency groups are substantial
Analysts see about 17% upside from current levels
watch: Organic revenue growth excluding the merger, and synergy delivery.
